name: Xciel XCiPhone 14
summary: The Xciel XCiPhone 14 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) case for the Apple iPhone 14, rated for Zone 2 under ATEX, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 14 running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc

certification.northAmerica: Class I Division 2, Groups A, B, C, D

safety.conditions: Case permanently sealed; removing the iPhone voids certification. Charging and wired accessories only outside hazardous areas (per Xciel family docs).
